description: Check an order: status (awaiting_payment → confirmed → printing → shipped → delivered), tracking number once shipped, and — while unpaid — the payment_url again (so you can always re-answer "how do I pay"). Requires the order_token from create_order, or the API key that created the order (Authorization: Bearer mp_live_...).

order_token.description: The token returned once by create_order. Optional if you send the API key that created the order instead.

name: get_order
